_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 29% coil base rate plus no single breaker (cool momentum/funding/MVRV offsetting flow and retail extremes) makes HOLD the skilled default while score stays inside 63-70.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both lean non-euphoric/cautious, but analyst explicitly calls Hope/HOLD medium while narrative supplies only flow color with no forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound near 83k, fear_greed holds 60-72, 30d momentum stays mid-range, ETF flows stay dead
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below 55 with downside acceleration (to Disbelief) or 30d momentum thrusts above 70 with ETF flows turning positive (to Optimism)
